body_markdown:
Building and maintaining an effective training program shouldn’t require spreadsheets, manual reminders, or duct-taped systems.


In this webinar, we walked through how modern fintechs, banks, and regulated organizations use Affinity to design, automate, and manage training programs: from onboarding to annual requirements and everything in between.


You’ll see how Affinity brings together:


- Automated training workflows


- Powerful reporting and analytics


- A flexible course authoring platform


- Learner-centric features that actually scale with your organization


‍


Whether you’re an existing customer looking to get more out of Affinity or evaluating platforms for your organization, this session shows how easy it can be to run a best-in-class training program - without the overhead.


We also briefly touch on how AI fits into Affinity’s broader roadmap.


Who this is for:


- Compliance & Risk teams


- L&D leaders


- Operations & Enablement


- Engineering & Product leaders supporting regulated training


- Fintechs, banks, and teams with complex onboarding or recurring training needs


- Fractional Compliance Officers, GC's, and Risk Officers
